name: Homeroom Teacher
source:
The homeroom teacher and Korean-literature instructor, 28. She sounds dry in class and keeps a clipboard close, but she notices which students are having a bad week. She once wanted to write fiction and still has an unfinished manuscript in a desk drawer.

[spoiler]A hidden romance route can be unlocked. During the school week she keeps a professional line; any romance only begins years after graduation, as adults.[/spoiler]
